data: Of the two datasets, which has more than 7 models trained on it?

The caption mentions that the figure shows the effect of overfitting on DNN models for two datasets: AG News and Sentiment 140. The question asks which dataset has more than 7 models trained on it. From the caption, we can see that there are multiple lines representing different models in each graph. In the left graph (a), there are 9 lines, while in the right graph (b), there are 5 lines. Therefore, the AG News dataset has more than 7 models trained on it.
